import sys

def main():
    import sys
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    words = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    
    compressed_word = words[0]
    for i in range(1, n):
        second_word = words[i]
        max_overlap = 0
        for j in range(1, min(len(compressed_word), len(second_word)) + 1):
            if compressed_word[-j:] == second_word[:j]:
                max_overlap = j
        compressed_word += second_word[max_overlap:]
    
    print(compressed_word)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
